notes.title: The Great Coffee Caper Demo - 1.02 - Update
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]Hello!
We have more changes for you all! These are primarily 3 big changes with a few small bug fixes sprinkled in.
[/p][h1][b]BUT FIRST![/b][/h1][p][i]Dearest reader![/i][/p][p][i]Do you have a need, a desire, a DEMAND for the wonderful music of [b]The Great Coffee Caper[/b]?[/i][/p][p][i]Look no further dear reader![/i][/p][p][b]Music from The Great Coffee Caper Demo is available on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, and MORE![/b][/p][p][i] [/i][url="https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3c6w0wq0oDxvNEECtIjwvUfTer_bYbzq&si=e45WMepGsjvjEhk2" style="button"]YouTube[/url][/p][p][url="https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/zectro/the-great-coffee-caper-demo-original-game-soundtrack" style="button"]Streaming Services[/url][/p][previewyoutube="g0LPhIHLhfw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]WHAT'S THAT DEAR READER!?[/b][/h2][h2][b]YOU WANT EVEN MORE!!??[/b][/h2][p align="start"][i]Well, your search is over![/i][/p][p][b]The full soundtrack of the demo is available for purchase on Steam and Bandcamp![/b][/p][p][i]Purchasing the soundtrack on [b]Steam[/b] also gives you [b]free updates[/b] to any new music added in the future![/i][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882420/The_Great_Coffee_Caper_Soundtrack/" style="button"]Steam[/url][/p][p][url="https://zectro.bandcamp.com/album/the-great-coffee-caper-demo-original-game-soundtrack" style="button"]Bandcamp[/url][/p][p][/p][h2][b]EVEN MORE!!!???[/b][/h2][p][i]FINE![/i][/p][p]For you, dear reader, I suppose I must...[/p][p][b]If you enjoy the music of [i]The Great Coffee Caper[/i], the original soundtrack's composer, Zectro, published a video showing a behind-the-scenes look![/b][/p][previewyoutube="xnpAhO3rgf0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]...[/i][/p][p][i]Ok, that's all for now, be thankful![/i][/p][h1]
[b]Version 1.02:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b][i]A certain attack of the Big Spark battle has been adjusted[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]The Big Spark's health has been increased[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]The Spark Glass's hitbox has been shrunk[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Flavor text has been added to Cup O Joe[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Fixed interactions outside of Cup O Joe[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Charlie no longer walks on water, he now walks on grass like any other self-respecting mouse[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]A new, more legible font option has been added[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]You can now choose between "Classic" font and "Clean" font when you first start up the game [/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="start"]Never fear! More changes are in the works![/p][p align="start"]Planned changes:[/p][list][*][p align="start"]Big changes to regular battles to make them more difficult and intriguing[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to change font in settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Small bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]If you find any issues or anything that seems odd, you can let us know in the Community Hub or in our Discord![/p][p align="start"][/p][h1]Final Thoughts[/h1][p]Thank you all so much for your support of the game! To God be the glory.[/p][p]We enjoy seeing all of your playthroughs online as well![/p][p]There is one more big hurdle for updates to the demo, regular battles, but after that, updates will slow unless they are absolutely critical. This is so development can begin on the full game![/p][p]Once again, thank you. Happy playing![/p][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Stay up to date![/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Discord: [/i][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6"]https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6[/url][/p][p align="start"][i]X: [/i][/p][p][url="https://x.com/EverydayMagicX"]https://x.com/EverydayMagicX[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p]

notes.title: The Great Coffee Caper Demo - 1.01 - Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello!
Thank you to everyone who has played the demo! We love seeing you all are enjoying it!

There are a number of changes and small improvements to the demo to make your experience more enjoyable. These are small bug fixes that will make your gameplay more consistent.[/p][p]
[b]Version 1.01:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]Fixed an issue where you could leave Clawdine's house before getting the hammer[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]The game now autosaves after certain cutscenes[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Fixed certain sprites not displaying properly[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Hootsworth now moves to a proper location in the closet[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Clawdine will stop being rude when you talk to her[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Fixed an issue where certain interactions would commence when not intended[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Removed the ability to access debug features[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Fixed typos in dialogue[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Certain interactions should be easier to commence[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Added furniture in Charlie's room[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Never fear! More changes are in the works![/p][p]Planned changes:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]new[/b] and [b]more legible[/b], font option. You will have the option to choose between the current "Classic" font and the new "Clean" font[/p][/*][*][p]A certain attack of the Big Spark is going to be [b]tweaked[/b] to be more [b]fair[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Charlie's [b]movements[/b] will be more [b]consistent[/b][/p][list][*][p]no more walking on water :([/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience![/p][p]If you find any issues or anything that seems odd, you can let us know in the Community Hub or in our Discord![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]Stay up to date![/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6"]https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6[/url][/i][/p][p align="start"][i]X: [url="https://x.com/EverydayMagicX"]https://x.com/EverydayMagicX[/url][/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! Just wanted to give a quick update about development.[/p][p]
We are currently working on a short demo for you all, and are getting closer each day to completing it. Here is a short list of things that need to be done:[/p][list][*][p]Finish up one more cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Boss battle[/p][/*][*][p]Sound design[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixing[/p][/*][/list][p]Some of these things (like the cutscene) are quicker to complete then others, and so I hope that it won't be too much longer until you all can play something. [/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience. This is our first game and so we never REALLY know how long something is going to take.[/p][p]That's all for now! Hope to have more to share soon![/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay up to date![/i][/p][p][i]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6"]https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6[/url][/i][/p][p][i]X: [url="https://x.com/EverydayMagicX"]https://x.com/EverydayMagicX[/url][/i][/p][p][/p]
